answer: Audits are published in nebula, queued in timber, and vault publishes the wait time. A farm of 370 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 30 identities per epoch. A farm of 1030 identities would post 2903 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
